Comment: RunStack Workflow - SSM Automation and Run Command support with native TargetLocations for cross-region/cross-account execution.

ExecuteSSMAutomationCommand.Comment: us-east-1 path - unchanged from original working version. Pure pass-through of automation_data.Parameters. No AutomationAssumeRole injected here.

ExecuteSSMAutomationCommandCrossRegion.Comment: Cross-region path via native TargetLocations. AutomationAssumeRole is auto-injected as the central admin role - caller never needs to set it.

CheckIfChildOutputNeeded.Comment: For us-east-1, the parent StepExecutions already contains the real output. For cross-region, the parent only has a pointer (ExecutionId) - fetch the child execution to get the real output.

GetChildAutomationOutput.Comment: Step Functions cannot make cross-region SDK calls natively, so this proxies through the existing runstack-ssm-region-proxy Lambda, which can target any region via boto3.

AutomationCompletedFinal.Comment: Route to the correct output source - east reads directly from the parent's StepExecutions, west reads from the child execution fetched via Lambda.

SetWestOutputFailed.Comment: Safety fallback - automation itself succeeded, but the child output lookup failed (e.g. Lambda error). Complete the job without crashing the whole execution.

Parameters.qualys_output: Automation succeeded but output could not be retrieved due to a cross-region lookup error.

FailAutomationWorkflow.Cause: Automation execution failed after 1 retry attempts

RecordAutomationDispatch.Comment: Execution Details: records the SSM ID on the job so per-server status and logs can be found. Best effort - a failed write continues to the same next state.

RecordAutomationTargetLocationsDispatch.Comment: Execution Details: records the SSM ID on the job so per-server status and logs can be found. Best effort - a failed write continues to the same next state.

RecordAutomationDispatchError.Comment: Execution Details: saves why Systems Manager rejected the dispatch (error + cause) on the job. Best effort - a failed write continues to the same retry check.

IsEC2PowerDocument.Comment: Only EC2 start/stop automations record live EC2 state; every other automation goes straight back to waiting, exactly as before.

CaptureLiveEC2State.Comment: Read-only: current EC2 state while the start/stop automation runs. Failure (e.g. instance outside this region) just continues waiting.

RecordLiveEC2State.Comment: Best effort: record the observed EC2 state on the job (ec2_state + first time each state was seen as seen_<state>_at) so GET /jobs shows live progress and transitions. Failures never affect the run.

RecordValidatedEC2State.Comment: Best effort: record the observed EC2 state on the job (ec2_state + first time each state was seen as seen_<state>_at) so GET /jobs shows live progress and transitions. Failures never affect the run.

InitStartHealth.Comment: Start jobs: keep the job open until EC2 status checks pass and SSM is Online (or timeout), so GET /jobs shows the full start-up.

GetStartInstanceStatus.Comment: Read-only: EC2 status checks during start-up.

GetStartSSMPing.Comment: Read-only: SSM agent PingStatus during start-up.

RecordStartHealth.Comment: Best effort: publish the latest health results on the job for GET /jobs.

RecordStartHealthOutcome.Comment: Best effort: final health outcome (passed / impaired / timeout / unavailable) plus seen_<outcome>_at for the transitions list. The job then completes as before.

LiveStateReachedTarget.Comment: Fast path: once the instance is observed in the target state (running for start, stopped for stop), go straight to EC2 validation (and, for start, the health loop) instead of waiting for the AWS automation to report Success. The automation finishes on its own in the background.

ExecuteSSMRunCommandCrossRegion.Comment: Cross-region RunCommand executes via a wrapper Automation document using native TargetLocations. StartAutomationExecution's Parameters field is always Map<String,List<String>> at the API level regardless of the document's own declared parameter types - every value must be array-wrapped, and StringMap-typed parameters (CommandParameters) must be a single-element array containing a JSON-encoded string.

MonitorSSMRunCommandCrossRegion.Comment: Monitors the wrapper Automation execution (central account) rather than a direct command invocation.

CheckWrapperStatusForChildFetch.Comment: Wait while the central TargetLocations wrapper is still running. Once terminal, fetch the target-region child Automation execution, which contains the real aws:runCommand step and its output.

GetRunCommandChildOutput.Comment: Fetch the TargetLocations child Automation from the target region/account through the existing region proxy Lambda.

NormalizeCrossRegionCommandStatus.Comment: Normalize the target-region child Automation result into the same command_status shape used by the existing RunCommand workflow.

FailCommandWorkflow.Cause: Command execution failed after 1 retry attempts

EnsureFailureOutputField.Comment: Hardcoded empty shape rather than JsonMerge against a possibly-nonexistent $.command_status, since this state runs on the failure/retry-exhausted path where no real command status was ever set.

RecordRunCommandDispatch.Comment: Execution Details: records the SSM ID on the job so per-server status and logs can be found. Best effort - a failed write continues to the same next state.

RecordRunCommandWrapperDispatch.Comment: Execution Details: records the SSM ID on the job so per-server status and logs can be found. Best effort - a failed write continues to the same next state.

RecordRunCommandDispatchError.Comment: Execution Details: saves why Systems Manager rejected the dispatch (error + cause) on the job. Best effort - a failed write continues to the same retry check.

WaitForCommandFirst.Comment: First status check 10 s after dispatch (later checks use WaitForCommand).

GetEC2InstanceStatus.Comment: Read-only: EC2 status checks (system, instance, attached EBS). IncludeAllInstances returns an entry for stopped instances too. Any failure (e.g. missing ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus on the cross-account role) falls back to 'unavailable' and never fails the state check.

GetSSMPingStatus.Comment: Read-only: SSM agent registration and PingStatus for the instance (server connectivity via SSM). Any failure (e.g. missing ssm:DescribeInstanceInformation) falls back to 'unavailable'.
